# Animation Performance

定位动效掉帧、布局与绘制开销；与尺寸振荡等布局问题区分后再优化。

下方原始文件保持上游语言与内容；中文任务要点为本站整理，不替代完整 Skill。
body.en:
# Animation Performance

Diagnose dropped frames and layout or paint costs; distinguish these from geometry feedback loops before optimizing.

Original files below retain the upstream language and contents. Atlas task notes do not replace the complete skill.

task.zh-CN: 先测量并复现掉帧或振荡，检查布局、绘制、合成与逐帧渲染，再验证改动前后的同一操作。
task.en: Measure and reproduce dropped frames or oscillation, inspect layout, paint, compositing and per-frame rendering, and compare the same interaction before and after.

usage.zh-CN: 普通对话：复制本站整理的任务要求，并补充你的项目需求。编程助手：先提供项目上下文，再按文件说明使用；下载不会自动安装或执行。
usage.en: Chat: copy the Atlas task notes and add your project requirements. Coding assistant: provide project context, then follow the file instructions. Downloads do not install or execute anything.
